card.name: The verb drink in patient instructions
card.fires_on: The word drink or drinking used as a verb or noun in instructions about what patients should or should not take by mouth, often after 'eat or' or 'avoid'.

modes.label: Eat or drink restrictions
modes.description: Drink after 'eat or' in fasting or avoidance instructions before a procedure or dose.
modes.example: Do not eat or<< drink>> anything except plain water, or take other

modes.label: Drink water or liquids
modes.description: Drink as an instruction to take fluids, such as water for hydration or a prepared solution.
modes.example: 2.3 Patient Preparation Instruct patients to<< drink>> water to ensure adequate hydration prior to administration

card.writes: It seems to push away alcohol-related words after drink, favoring other continuations such as water or liquids.
card.plain: It lights up on the word drink in instructions about what to eat or drink before a dose or scan.
